DIAGNOSTICS AUTOMATIC TRANSAXLE (U341 E)
4 I Check shift solenoid valve ST.
Electrical check:
PREPARATION:
(a) Jack up the vehicle.
(b) Remove the oil pan.
(c) Disconnect the solenoid connector.
(d) Remove the shift solenoid valve ST.
CHECK:
(a) Measure resistance between solenoid connector and
body ground.
(b) Connect positive (£l lead to terminal of solenoid connec­
tor, negative e lead to solenoid body.
OK:
(a) Resistance: 11 -15 n at 20 ·c (68 °F)
(b) The solenoid makes an operating noise.
Mechanical check:

(a) Jack up the vehicle.
(b) Remove the oil pan.
(c) Disconnect the solenoid connector.
(d) Remove the shift solenoid valve ST
CHECK:
